Skip & Loafer Anime's 2nd Season Reveals More Cast in 1st Promo Video

items.source_excerpt: The official website for the Skip to Loafer (Skip and Loafer) television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, new key visual, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Monday. The second season adapting Misaki Takamatsu's coming-of-age manga will premiere in April 2027. Voice actresses Reina Ueda (Mao) and Yuuto Takenaka (Saijo no Osewa) are joining in the anime as Chieri Yasaka and Kiyohiko Ujiie, respectively.
